summary_1line: Demons called Kalakeyas secretly slaughter sages at night; the gods appeal to Vishnu, who reveals they hide in the ocean and suggests Agastya can dry it.

image_candidates.scene_text: At dawn, the forest hermitage is strewn with the mutilated bodies and white bones of ascetics beside shattered sacrificial jars and extinguished sacred fires.
The frightened gods gather around Vishnu in Vaikuntha, bowing and pleading for protection as the universe falls into chaos.
The gods arrive at the radiant sage Agastya’s hermitage, where the resplendent seer sits surrounded by sages like Brahma among celestials.
